text:
- Total revenue reached £157,505.13 TW, representing a 21.2% WoW increase from £129,975.51 LW.
- Total revenue grew 241.2% YoY in ISO week 2010-W49, demonstrating strong year-over-year performance.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER maintained the top position with £10,902.59 TW revenue and 6.9% share TW, though it declined 4.8% WoW.
- VINTAGE UNION JACK MEMOBOARD ranked second with £6,561.83 TW revenue and 4.2% share TW, surging 1528.2% WoW.
- UTILTY CABINET WITH HOOKS achieved the largest WoW increase at 3003.8%, growing from £80.85 LW to £2,509.44 TW.
- HAND WARMER OWL DESIGN experienced the largest WoW decrease of 75.1%, falling from £2,542.97 LW to £633.57 TW.
- ENGLISH ROSE HOT WATER BOTTLE recorded the largest YoY increase of 35879.3%, rising from £1.50 LY.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER generated the most orders at 86 TW compared to 81 LW.
